release-identity:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require publication workflow and source from the exact release tag
        env:
          WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
          WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
        run: |
          python3 deploy/release/ci_policy.py --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
            --workflow-ref "$WORKFLOW_REF" --workflow-sha "$WORKFLOW_SHA" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/phorge-release-ci-identity.json"
      - name: Verify release rejection paths
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/release -p 'test_*.py' -v
  full-regressions:
    needs: release-identity
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release-full.yml
    with:
      expected_head: ${{ github.sha }}

media-isolation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - family: mysql
            image: mysql:8.4.13@sha256:a0225d1ea6631c8bc2385dc4c2faba17bbf1834ecf369e1659a9a382bd8d5dd7
          - family: mariadb
            image: mariadb@sha256:d769e37960821dfdcf096954f6e7ac89f747e116c1bba98e48edd265dfc7deae
    services:
      database:
        image: ${{ matrix.image }}
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: media-isolation-test-only
          MYSQL_ROOT_HOST: '%'
        ports: ['3306:3306']
        options: --health-cmd "mysqladmin --protocol=tcp --host=127.0.0.1 ping --silent" --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5.12'
          ini-values: opcache.jit=disable, opcache.jit_buffer_size=0
          extensions: mysqli, mbstring, curl
          coverage: none
      - name: Verify isolation row validation without database access
        run: |
          php -r 'require "tests/contract/bootstrap.php"; $test = new PhorgeGovernanceMediaExchangeServiceTestCase(); $test->testIsolationRowsKeepExactNamesAndKnownNativeValues(); $assertions = new ReflectionProperty(PhutilTestCase::class, "assertions"); if ($assertions->getValue($test) !== 22) { throw new RuntimeException("Unexpected assertion count."); }'
      - name: Verify isolated media transactions and cleanup
        env:
          PHORGE_MEDIA_ISOLATION_TEST: '1'
          PHORGE_MEDIA_DATABASE_FAMILY: ${{ matrix.family }}
          PHORGE_MEDIA_MYSQL_HOST: 127.0.0.1
          PHORGE_MEDIA_MYSQL_PASSWORD: media-isolation-test-only
        run: php tests/contract/runtime/media-isolation.php
  proxy-session-identity:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      mysql:
        image: mysql:8.0
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: proxy-session-test-only
          MYSQL_ROOT_HOST: '%'
        ports: ['3306:3306']
        options: --health-cmd "mysqladmin ping -pproxy-session-test-only" --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.5.12'
          ini-values: opcache.jit=disable, opcache.jit_buffer_size=0
          extensions: mysqli, mbstring, curl, dom
          coverage: none
      - name: Prepare isolated authentication test database
        run: |
          php scripts/runtime/build.php all
          mkdir -p conf/local
          php -r '$db=new mysqli("127.0.0.1","root","proxy-session-test-only","",3306); $db->query("SET GLOBAL sql_mode = '\''STRICT_ALL_TABLES'\''"); file_put_contents("conf/local/local.json",json_encode(["mysql.host"=>"127.0.0.1","mysql.port"=>"3306","mysql.user"=>"root","mysql.pass"=>"proxy-session-test-only"]));'
      - name: Verify proxy identity and explicit account linking
        run: |
          php bin/unit --no-coverage \
            src/applications/auth/__tests__/PhabricatorTraefikSessionIdentityTestCase.php \
            src/applications/auth/__tests__/PhabricatorTraefikAuthProviderTestCase.php
      - name: Verify native Almanac inventory boundaries
        run: php bin/unit --no-coverage src/applications/almanac/__tests__/AlmanacInventoryBoundaryTestCase.php

Their presence and unit tests are not proof of complete N09/N10 qualification.

browser exchange, cross-account and session lifecycle, all retained file routes,
and cleanup/recovery tests together. Private-mail producer integration has its
own N11 qualification. This engine alone is not N09/N10/N11 completion,
production enablement, or a migration of any native project permission axis.

remain. In particular, rejecting another account at a file details page does not
prove that account cannot read a secret raw-file URL. Ordinary application login
or gateway admission must not be reported as session-bound media authorization.

[[wiki page]]             # Link to Phriction

= Phriction Documents =

You can link to Phriction documents with a name or path:

  Make sure you sign and date your [[legal/Letter of Marque and Reprisal]]!

By default, the link will render with the document title as the link name.
With a pipe (`|`), you can retitle the link. Use this to mislead your
opponents:

  Check out these [[legal/boring_documents/ | exciting legal documents]]!

Links to pages which do not exist are shown in red. Links to pages which exist
but which the viewer does not have permission to see are shown with a lock
icon, and the link will not disclose the page title.

If you begin a link path with `./` or `../`, the remainder of the path will be
evaluated relative to the current wiki page. For example, if you are writing
content for the document `fruit/` a link to `[[./guava]]` is the same as a link
to `[[fruit/guava]]` from elsewhere.

Relative links may use `../` to transverse up the document tree. From the
`produce/vegetables/` page, you can use `[[../fruit/guava]]` to link to the
`produce/fruit/guava` page.

Relative links do not work when used outside of wiki pages. For example,
you can't use a relative link in a comment on a task, because there is no
reasonable place for the link to start resolving from.

When documents are moved, relative links are not automatically updated: they
are preserved as currently written. After moving a document, you may need to
review and adjust any relative links it contains.

  Empty existing body adds native deletion; move-to adds destination view/edit
  policies. Creation, restore/publish validation and final effects remain outside
  the supported closure. A destination must be the exact native document class.

edits.current: Wiki observation methods have been retired with the native Wiki application.
edits.parent:
`observeWikiBatchExpansion()` invokes the exact native Wiki batch prelude on
an existing document with explicitly attached native `PhrictionContent`. Its
stored content identity and document binding must match. The native uint32
version accepts a positive integer or canonical decimal string in 1–4294967295;
leading zeroes, signs, floats, booleans and overflow are refused. The public
version summary is normalized to an integer without mutating the input. The prelude records old content in the throwaway editor before the
native per-item expansion. Tests cover combined move-policy and empty-content
delete ordering. Returned context includes only version and identity digest;
attached body text is not exported or modified. Attachment consistency is not
proof that the provided objects are fresh database rows.
